Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities to assays on assay_id, molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644'. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation = '='. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
